test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I will never forget the feeling of receiving a prestigious award, with my parents sitting among the audience and __jostling with their emotion.__
solution: The correct answer is: **applauding my success**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"jostling with their emotion"** is incorrect as it means "struggling or pushing with emotions", which doesn’t convey the intended feeling of pride or happiness. (अपने भावनाओं से जूझना) • **Example:** He was jostling with his emotions after hearing the bad news. • The correct phrase **"applauding my success"** means “clapping or expressing approval and pride for someone’s achievement.” (मेरी सफलता पर तालियाँ बजाना / प्रशंसा करना) • **Example:** My teachers were applauding my success when I received the award on stage. • Hence, the phrase **"applauding my success"** correctly conveys the meaning of pride and happiness in the given context. Therefore, the correct answer is: **applauding my success**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Supporting my fear** (मेरे डर का समर्थन करना): This phrase doesn’t fit the context as parents would not support fear but encourage courage.** **Example:** True friends don’t support your fear; they help you overcome it. • **Pray for me** (मेरे लिए प्रार्थना करना): While meaningful, it doesn’t convey the scene of pride and applause during an award ceremony. **Example:** My parents always pray for me before every exam. • **Hiding their nervousness** (अपनी घबराहट छिपाना): This implies anxiety, which doesn’t fit the positive tone of receiving an award. **Example:** She was hiding her nervousness before going on stage. 35:Tcf6, The correct answer is: Elementary**.
